newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEAKER AGAINST HARD UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEAKER AGAINST HARD UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar finished Tuesday's interbank session weaker against hard currencies in quiet pre-Christmas trade, dealers said.
"Not much happened today. We had a couple of receipts but there were no major payments going out," a trader said.
"Most companies are starting to close down for Christmas so we don't expect much activity between now and year-end," he added.
At Tuesday's close, the local dollar was quoted at 10.7625/7825 against the U.S. dollar, up from 10.7700/7900 in the morning but down on late Monday's 10.7550/7750.

It was at 17.9217/9658 against pound sterling compared to 17.8500/8700 overnight, and at 6.9480/9641 against the mark, up from 6.9700/9870 earlier in the day but weaker compared to 6.9200/9400 overnight.
On the rand, the Zimbabwe dollar ended the day firmer at 2.2742/2808 after finishing at 2.2800/3000 on Monday.
